* Retrieving a specific card can be reduced from 1 card retrieved to 0.
* Code Clearance stacks an Interrupt after it retrieves Force. By this time, the Interrupt could already have been stacked on another grabber (e.g. [[Allegations Of Corruption]]) first, in which case it remains on that first grabber.
* Code Clearance can stack an Interrupt before [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough{{!}}This Place Can Be A Little Rough]] can place it out of play.
* [[Outrider]] places Utinni Effects out of play before Code Clearance can stack.
* DS cards such as [[You Swindled Me!]] may be stacked.

A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (22 January 2023). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Cor-D-dotheyhaveacodeclearance-PC-Errata-2023-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Do They Have A Code Clearance? (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): Same words as the previous version. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2023 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
